# Incremental Reconcile

The reconcile function processes only merged pull requests and direct commits that occurred after a certain timestamp. This allows efficient updates without needing to recompile the entire repository.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
